actions.reason: Shop logs 'PAYMENTS_TOKEN is not set' and app.py reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN, but .env defines PAYMENT_TOKEN (typo in key name); renaming the key keeps the existing value.
Reload .env with corrected PAYMENTS_TOKEN key name.

root_causes.evidence: Shop log: 'PAYMENTS_TOKEN is not set'; payments log: 401 invalid or missing API token; .env had key PAYMENT_TOKEN (typo) while app.py reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN.

report.summary: Checkout returned 502 because .env defined PAYMENT_TOKEN instead of PAYMENTS_TOKEN, so the shop sent no token and the payments connector returned 401. I renamed the key and kept the existing value. I did not create or change any secret. I restarted shop, and all 5 smoke tests pass, including a checkout that returned 201 with the order saved.
